verdict.rationale: Daytona's pricing page states "$200 in free compute included" and describes usage-based, pay-for-what-you-use consumption. That points to self-serve credits without a sales conversation. The open-source repo is also described as free to use and build on, though only "as is and without support." missing for 10: explicit documentation of self-serve signup/API-key flow with no sales contact, details on credit terms (expiry, rate/resource limits on the free allotment), independent or hands-on corroboration of the free-credit onboarding.
